changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 1.0.93[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]TheTVDB[/COLOR]
-TheTVDB now works alongside TMDb, TVmaze, Fanart.tv and your tracking services, for every series, with nothing to set up.
-More sources for series numbered differently: when TMDb groups seasons differently from TheTVDB (split or merged seasons, parts), Knaben, The Pirate Bay, Easynews and Newznab also search the TheTVDB episode number, matched by air date. Anime is also searched by absolute number ("Show - 48").
-Missing episode details: when TMDb has no title, plot, air date or picture for an episode, TheTVDB fills the gap, in your language when available. Nothing TMDb already has is replaced.
-Series artwork: when TMDb has no poster or background, TheTVDB's is used.
-New TheTVDB section in Settings > Accounts, with switches for both features and optional fields for your own TheTVDB key and PIN.
[COLOR fffdb515]Faster menus[/COLOR]
-Channel and studio logos in TV Shows > Networks and Originals now load from the Studio Icons - Coloured pack by Team Kodi instead of slow free image hosts. The Networks menu now opens in about 0.15 seconds.
-Networks also uses the platform logos built into the add-on. SkyShowtime, whose old logo link was dead, shows its logo again, and Showcase (Australia) gets its own instead of Canada's.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-Library: the TV source set up by the add-on now uses TheTVDB v4 when installed, or Kodi's built-in TMDb TV scraper, instead of the old TheTVDB scraper that stopped working in 2022.
-Trakt: looking up a title by its ID no longer fails when Trakt lists a result of another type first.
-Updating the add-on no longer logs an error when the catalog service was busy at that moment.
